nodes.name: Coordinator tools
nodes.responsibility: Runs the tool calls the coordinator makes, once each, against a replay ledger; each workhorse tool names the checkout whose workhorse it works with, and a spoken stop names none

nodes.name: Semantic context
nodes.responsibility: What changed on the boards of the tab's panes, and what a pane shows or picked out: the events Archboard announces to the coordinator and the voice

nodes.name: Tab sessions
nodes.responsibility: Sends each tool call and notification to the tab session whose thread it names: that session's coordinator tools and callbacks, and its workhorses

nodes.name: Coordinator turn homes
nodes.responsibility: Remembers, for each coordinator turn, the conversation shown when it started and the checkouts it gave work to, so the page shows the turn in the right conversation

nodes.name: Tools and work
nodes.responsibility: What the coordinator may ask for: the frozen tool contract, the tool calls it runs once each, a spoken approval, and where each turn that gave work is shown

nodes.name: Coordinator news
nodes.responsibility: What the coordinator and the voice model are told while voice is live: workhorse news and announced context changes, in order, the outcome report, and the Archboard context they come from

nodes.name: Board catalogue
nodes.responsibility: Archboard's context for the coordinator: the catalogue of the boards and variants in the vault of the pane the session presents through, read whole

nodes.name: Archboard announcements
nodes.responsibility: Archboard's board changes, focus and selection, worded for the coordinator and the voice and announced through the voice agent

nodes.name: Context announcements
nodes.responsibility: Tells a tab session's coordinator and live voice a context change the host announces, each through the tab's one callback queue, and only while voice is live

edges.label: a tool call from the coordinator
note a turn's start and the work its operations give
